Commentary.Commentary: Vijay Shankar says it's been a good show from them. Reckons bowling back of a length is something which doesn't let batsman score freely and hence he likes to hit it more often. Is trying to adapt to the situation and is happy to do it. States they are backing themselves to chase this down.

Bangladesh will be very disappointed with their effort. Apart from Liton Das and Sabbir Rahman none of the batsmen got going and now it's a tough ask for their bowlers to defend a paltry score against a star-studded batting line-up. Will India continue to keep wood over Bangladesh? We shall find out in just a bit. We have Vijay Shankar up for a chat. Let's see what the pacer has to say...

Excellent performance from India after opting to bowl. They were right on the money from the word go and never did they let Bangladesh off the hook. All their bowlers got into the act pretty quickly especially after that thrashing that they received in the series opener. Unadkat got three while Thakur got two to his name. Both their spinners were pretty economical and tidy. They gave away just 42 runs and picked up a wicket in the 8 overs together.
Another one on a shorter length, Thakur grunts as he delivers it. Taskin Ahmed mistimes his pull to mid-wicket and settles for a single. BANGLADESH FINISH WITH 139/8!
Wide! This seems to have slipped out of his hands! Full toss, too, too wide outside the tramline. A good take from Karthik behind.
Comes a couple of steps ahead and drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Bangs in a short one, directing towards the batsman. Rahman is ages to late to swing across the line.
Drags a pull off the inside edge towards mid-wicket for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman is next.

OUT! Run out! Very full on the stumps, Taskin Ahmed drags it off the inner half towards long on and runs the first one hard. He wants another as well and Rubel sets off. Raina fires a flat throw to Shardul who seems to have not collected it cleanly but did well to deflect it onto the stumps at his end. They take it upstairs and replays confirm the same.
Direct hit, is it? Or has Thakur not collected the ball? Either way, the stumps are disturbed and a run out appeal is taken upstairs.
Hits the deck hard, it rises a bit too much and it's too good for Taskin to hit it across.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Rubel Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! Sabbir Rahman has to walk back. It's not a bump ball, so Sabbir Rahman's stay ends as Unadkat gets his third of the night. He goes wide of the crease and angles away a very full ball outside off, Rahman tries squeezing it out but there seems to be some noise as the ball passes the bat. The umpire takes his time before raising his finger. Sabbir is quick to take the DRS. Replays roll in. Snicko shows a spike but not when the bat hits the ground. It shows when the ball passes the bat. The decision stands.
The umpire raises the finger to a caught behind appeal against Sabbir Rahman. It seems like a bump ball and hence Sabbir takes the review straightaway.
Wide! That's ultra wide! Very full and miles outside the tramline, Sabbir lets it be.
That's a harsh call from the umpire! The cutter from Jaydev, it moves away a bit, Rahman looks to pull but gets beaten. It was well inside the tramline.
Doles a yorker, sprayed wider outside off, Sabbir Rahman fails to dig it out.
SIX! That's gone the distance! What a hit! Rahman maybe, predicted this as he waits on the back foot to a length ball and pummels it over deep square leg for a maximum.

Leg bye! Angling in again on middle and leg, Ahmed looks to tuck it away but gets it off the pads. The ball rolls beside the pitch as Sabbir calls him through. Taskin obliges. Now Unadkat charges to the ball, picks it up, turns and has a wild shy at the bowler's end but misses. The man from mid off does well to stop it with a dive.

FOUR! Bangladesh have finally got a boundary. They need more of those! Fuller and angling in from over the wicket, Ahmed clears the front leg and whips it between long on and mid-wicket for a boundary to start the 19th over.
Yes, he does! Back to over the wicket and digs in a short ball on leg, Taskin lifts his front leg as he pulls it towards fine leg to be on strike. Excellent from Shardul, just two off the over.
Goes around the wicket and angles away a length delivery on off, clipped towards mid-wicket. Just one from the over  so far, can Shardul finish well?
Good length delivery on middle, Rahman finally connects. Gets it towards mid-wicket but doesn't want another.
Third time beaten! This time it's the knuckle ball from Thakur. Sabbir swings wildly at it and gets beaten comprehensively.
Rolls his fingers over the ball, this one moves away from off, Sabbir makes room to guide it fine towards third man but gets beaten due to the lack of pace.
On a back of a length, closer to the off stump line. Sabbir swings and misses.
Shardul Thakur to bowl the 18th over.
Bangs in a short one on middle and off, Taskin rises on the toes as he stabs it out towards backward point.
Shortish on the hips, Rahman hops and tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Taskin Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! Easy take for Pandey! Unadkat with an excellent slower length delivery on middle and off, Mehidy Hasan backs away to have a thwack across the line but all he manages is to sky it up in the air towards long on where Manish Pandey takes it safely.
Wide! Bangs in a short one on middle and leg, Hasan can't pull it away. Wide called rightly.
Comes from around the wicket and drops it on a back of a length outside off, Rahman pushes it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Much-needed! Short and a bit of width on offer, Sabbir Rahman pounces on it as he flashes it through point for a boundary.
Angles it away on a length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Jaydev Unadkat is back into the attack.
Slower through the air, clipped with soft hands towards mid-wicket. Chahal himself does the mopping up work and he's done for the night. His figures read 4-0-19-1!
Drops it short on middle, pulled with ample of time through mid-wicket for a single.
Gets down and paddle scoops it over the keeper for a single.
Sends in a googly this time, Rahman works it with the turn through mid-wicket for a single.
More loop this time, Rahman blocks it out.
Mehidy Hasan walks in next.

OUT! Chahal strikes! He comes back into the attack and breaks the stand that was starting to bloom a bit. He gives it a good flight, lands it around middle and off. Liton Das skips down the track to go big but the ball turns away a bit which made him reach out to that one. Mistimes it high in the air towards long off and Raina takes it with ease by coming a couple of steps ahead.
Yuzvendra Chahal is back.
FOUR! Well played! Makes the most of the Free Hit! Walks across to a low full toss and paddles it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary to end the over. 11 coming from the long, long over.
Now a no ball! Shankar is just not able to complete his over or what? Very full on off, driven towards cover. Das wanted a single but is sent back. Free Hit time!
Wide! Another wide! Fuller ball, a bit wider outside off, SR looks to drive but misses.
Wide! Bumper one on middle and leg, Sabbir lets it be.

In the air... dropped! But what an effort from Vijay Shankar! Simply terrific. Changes the pace again, keeps it full outside off, Rahman looks to heave it across the line but mistimes it high in the air towards mid-wicket. Shankar himself charges towards the ball, covers good ground and then stretches both his hands but the ball doesn't stick. Talk about athleticism! 100 up for Bangladesh as the batsmen take two.
Good delivery! Bowls a slower back of a length delivery outside off, Sabbir Rahman swivels to pull but is undone by the slowness on the ball.
Tucks a length delivery towards backward square leg and runs one.
Shuffles across to play the scoop, Shankar drops it short on middle. The batsman can't get going with the shot.
Shortish and angling in on middle, Sabbir helps/pulls it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Vijay Shankar is back into the attack.
Flattish outside off, Sabbir dabs it towards short third man to keep strike. Washington Sundar finishes with figures of 4-0-23-0! Very economical!
Darted on the pads, worked through square leg for a single.
Wide! Goes around the wicket and fires it too wide outside off. Liton still goes after it but misses.
Loops it up outside off, Das chips it over extra cover and collects a brace.
This time the conventional sweep is played! Loopy delivery outside off, swept behind square on the leg side for a single.
Low full toss on the stumps, Das looks to play the reverse sweep but gets it off the bottom edge towards short third man for a single.
FOUR! 8 from the last two balls! Floated delivery around middle and off, Liton Das dances down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Ahh, the extra ball costs India a boundary here! Fuller in length and outside off, Rahman drives it on the up and splits the gap between extra cover and mid off.
Bends his back and hits the deck hard does Shardul, Rahman tries to pull it across the line but this one bounces way over him to the keeper. Wide called for the height.
Fuller and angling in on the pads, nudged through mid-wicket for another single.
Since the mid off is inside the circle, Shardul fires in a yorker outside off, Das tries to jam it out but fails to get any wood on it.
Good length delivery on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Another mishit! Short ball, a well-directed one. Das mistimes the pull towards deep square leg where Dhawan collects it on the bounce.

Liton Das gives the charge, Thakur spots it and smartly drags his length back. Since the batsman is down he had to play the pull shot. Gets it off the splice over the bowler for a couple before the man from long off mops it up.
Shardul Thakur comes on to bowl now.
Fires it right at the base of the stumps, Rahman just jams it out. Another fruitful over for India, just 6 from the last two and plus a wicket as well.
Floated ball outside off, Das gets down to sweep but mistimes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Goes deep in the crease to a quicker ball and punches it towards cover.
Wide! Full toss down the leg side, it seems to have slipped out of his hands.
Goes back and clips it through square leg for a single.
Flatter and quicker through the air, Sabbir rocks back to cut. Beaten again.
Tossed up outside off, Rahman prods forward to defend, expecting the ball to turn but it doesn't. It goes straight on and he gets beaten.
Washington Sundar back on.

What was that? A wicket has just fallen and Liton Das attempts a cheeky shot. He walks across to a length ball and tries to paddle it over the keeper but gets beaten comprehensively. Just 3 runs and a wicket off it.
Sabbir Rahman is the next man in.

OUT! Gone! The pressure of dot balls gets the better of the Bangladeshi skipper. Back of a length delivery outside off, Mahmudullah makes room to hit it inside out but ends up slicing it towards sweeper cover where Shardul Thakur comes a couple of steps ahead and takes an easy catch. Bangladesh dented further.
Fuller ball on middle and off, worked straight to mid on. Turning out to be a good over so far.
Bangs in a short one on middle and off, Mahmudullah looks to pull but gets beaten.
Nothing on the Free Hit! Fuller ball, angling in, Liton swings across the line but gets it off the inner half to long on for a single.
That's a wide this time! Fuller ball but miles down the leg side, Das shuffles across and leaves it alone. Free Hit is still on.
Free hit coming up...
Very full, almost a yorker outside off, Liton crouches low and squeezes it out towards cover. The umpire calls it a no ball as Shankar has overstepped big time.
Beaten! Shankar drops it on a length and it moves away from off, Das walks across to pull it but misses it completely.
Chahal darts it full outside off, Mahmudullah plays it to point. At the end of 10 overs, Bangladesh are 69-3.
Das sweeps it to mid-wicket for a single.
Chahal fires it full on the legs, Mahmudullah plays it to mid-wicket for another single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Mahmudullah gets an inside edge to a tossed up delivery and it hits his pads.
Das leans into the tossed up delivery and drives it to mid-wicket for a single.
Mahmudullah gets a bottom edge to a full delivery on the leg stump. The ball rolls to the keeper.
Mahmudullah comes in at no. 5.

OUT! India have a decision in their favour. Shankar bowls it wide outside off, Rahim tries to put bat to it but seems to have found the outside edge and the ball goes into the keeper's gloves. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Karthik asks for a referral immediately. Replays roll in, they check for the front foot first, it's touch and go but the umpire gives it in the bowler's favour. Also there is clear indication on Snicko that he has found the outside edge. Rahim has to go back to the pavilion. Good use of the technology by the Men in Blue this time. The batting side are in big trouble here. Needless by Rahim.
A referral has been taken by India for a caught behind appeal. Mushfiqur Rahim is the man in question.

SIX! That is huge! Shankar bangs it short on the leg stump, Rahim pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum. You cannot afford to bowl short deliveries at this pace or else you will get smacked which is just what Rahim did.
Das opens the face of the bat and plays it to point for a single.
A length delivery outside off, Das comes dancing down the track but fails to make any contact.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Das rocks on the back foot and punches it past covers for a boundary.
Das sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and keeps the strike for next over.
Tossed up delivery on the leg side, Rahim tries to sweep it but the ball hits the back leg and they sneak in a single.
Das comes dancing down the wicket and plays it to long off for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Rahim cuts it to point fielder and they come for a single.
Rahim drives it back to the bowler.
Rahim gets a leading edge to a tossed up delivery but falls just short of the bowler.
Shankar bowls a back of a length delivery on the stumps, Das rocks on the back foot and defends it.

Second drop in 3 balls! Again, it's Liton Das who has survived. Shankar bangs it short on the leg stump, Liton pulls it to deep fine leg where Sundar tries to run in and take a low catch. The ball hits his hands but he cannot hold on to it. The batsmen still take two runs.
Played to mid-wicket for a single.

DROPPED! Is the fielder, Suresh Raina who has dropped it? Ohh yes it's him! Shankar bowls a length ball outside off, Liton pulls it and gets a top edge to it. Raina comes in running from mid off and takes it too casually. He drops a simple catch. By then the batsmen sneak a single.

Leading edge but safe. Shankar bangs it short on the legs, Das tries to clip if off his hips but gets an leading edge to it. The balls goes to the deep mid-wicket region and the batsmen come for a brace.
Rahim inside edges a full delivery on the stumps and the ball rolls to mid-wicket as they sneak a single.
Vijay Shankar will have a bowl.
Rahim plays it to mid- wicket for a single. At the end of Powerplay, Bangladesh are 44-2.
FOUR! Two consecutive boundaries. Rahim slog sweeps a tossed up delivery towards deep mid wicket for a boundary.

FOUR! Good improvisation by the batsman. He sees that Chahal has been tossing it up outside off so decides to play the reverse sweep. He connects it well and the ball goes over the point region for a boundary.
Rahim tries to play it to the leg side but only manages to find the bottom edge to it.
Tossed up delivery on the middle stump, defended well by the batsman.
Rahim gets forward and defends it from the crease.
Yuzvendra Chahal to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
Mushfiqur Rahim comes in at no. 4.

OUT! Thakur gets his man at last. An LBW decision was overturned on the third ball of this over and then Shardul got hit for two consecutive boundaries. So, Thakur has the last laugh. He bangs in a short one, changes the pace cleverly and puts Tamim into a tangle. The southpaw goes for the pull but gets a top edge instead and Unadkat at short fine leg takes a dolly.
FOUR! Back to back boundaries for Tamim. He comes dancing down the track to a back of a length delivery outside off and lofts it over the mid off fielder. Tamim looks to be in some attacking mood.
FOUR! If you bowl deliveries like this with your field up then you'll get punished. A full delivery outside off stump, Iqbal leans into the drive and gets it past covers for another boundary.

Pitching outside leg! The on-field call has to be overturned here! Good use of the review by Tamim! Thakur delivers a fuller ball around leg, Tamim looks to flick but misses and gets rapped on the pads, nearly falls over as he tried to attempt that shot. A loud shout for an LBW and the umpire after taking his time, raises the finger. Tamim has a word with his partner and then takes the DRS. Nothing on Hot Spot and Hawk Eye shows it to be pitching outside leg. That's that then!
A referral for an LBW decision has been taken by Tamim Iqbal. The umpire has given out on this occasion.
Well bowled! Thakur lands it on a length outside off, Tamim looks to drive at it but gets beaten by the movement away from the batsman.
Thakur starts by bowling a short delivery outside off, Iqbal cuts it to the point region.
Shardul Thakur comes into bowl. He had a forgetful first over in the last match.
FOUR! Good shot by Das. Sundar tosses it up outside off, the batsman goes on one knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for his first boundary. Just five runs came off that over.
Played to mid-wicket for the first run of the over.
Iqbal gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to covers.
Iqbal cuts a short delivery outside off to the point region. Three consecutive dot balls.
Sundar darts it full on the legs, the batsman flicks it to mid-wicket.
Iqbal drives a tossed up delivery to mid off.
Iqbal plays it to mid-wicket for a single. A successful over for India comes to an end.
Liton Das is off the mark on the first ball he faces. He flicks it to square leg for a single.
Liton Das comes in at no. 3.

OUT! Unadkat draws first blood. One shot too many for Soumya. He looks to flick a length ball on the stumps over the short fine leg fielder but instead gives it into the hands of Yuzvendra Chahal stationed over there. Good catch by the leggie as he dives forward to take it. Unadkat looks delighted.
Unadkat bangs it way too short as the ball goes way above the batsman's head. The umpire signals it a wide.
In the air but safe! Soumya comes dancing down from his position to a length delivery outside off. He chips it over the mid off fielder and calls his partner for a brace.

SIX! First maximum of the innings. You cannot afford to bowl deliveries like these. Unadkat bowls it on the legs, Soumya sees the opportunity and flicks it with some timing over the square leg boundary for a maximum.
Good shot but just for a single. Unadkat drags it on the legs, Tamim flicks it off his hips to deep square leg for a single.
Sundar strays in his line. He tosses it up on the legs, Soumya flicks it to short fine leg. Good end to the over by Sundar.
Washington bowls it quick and a tad short outside off. Soumya cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Soumya drives a tossed up delivery to mid off.
Well bowled. He bowls it slower and full outside off. Soumya leans for the drive but gets beaten by the turn on the delivery.
Soumya opens the face of the bat and plays it to the point region.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings. Poor delivery to begin with. He drags it wide and short outside off, Soumya sees it and smacks it past the cover fielder for a boundary.
Washington Sundar will start from the other end.

OHH! A narrow escape for Soumya. Unadkat bowls a length delivery on the stumps, Soumya goes for the flick but edges it and the ball flies towards the third man region. Pandey runs back from backward point and Sundar comes in running from the third man region but no one goes for the catch. By then the batsmen complete a run.
Unadkat strays in line. He bowls it on his legs, Tamim quickly latches on the opportunity. He plays it towards the square leg region and the batsmen complete three runs. Good running by the duo.
Unadkat lands it on a back of length on the stumps, Soumya gets squared up by the delivery. The ball takes the outside edge and gets past the backward point for a single.
Well bowled! He lands it on a good length area just outside off, Soumya gets beaten by the movement of the pitch.
Bangladesh are off the mark. Unadkat bowls it a tad short on his hips, Tamim clips it to fine leg for a single.

Good first delivery to start with. This ball lands on a back of a length area and moves away from the batsman. He looks to play at it but then decides to leave it at the end moment. Good carry to the wicketkeeper.
Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar will open the innings for Bangladesh. Jaydev Unadkat will have the brand new ball in hand. One slip in place to start with.
The players are out in the middle and they will pay respect to their respective national anthems. We're just few minutes away from the start of the match.
Bangladesh playing XI - Tamim Iqbal, Soumya Sarkar, Mahmudullah (C), Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Liton Das, Sabbir Rahman, Mehidy Hasan, Nazmul Islam, Rubel Hossain, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman.

India playing XI -  Rohit Sharma (C), Shikhar Dhawan, Suresh Raina, Manish Pandey, Rishabh Pant, Dinesh Karthik (WK), Washington Sundar, Vijay Shankar, Jaydev Unadkat, Yuzvendra Chahal, Shardul Thakur.

Bangladesh captain, Mahmudullah says that he would have bowled first as well but will anyway look to put a good show with the bat. Adds that they played a practice match over here and all the players had a good time in their respective departments. Reckons that they will look to execute their skills and use it to their potential. Ends by saying that they are playing with 6 batsmen and 5 bowlers.

India captain, Rohit Sharma starts by saying that the wicket got better as the game went on, so why not use it to their advantage as they are playing on the same track. On asking about the team news, he adds that he believes in backing his players so there are no changes in the side. Ends by saying that he believes in their potential and hopes that by giving them another chance they'll come good.
Toss - Rohit Sharma spins the coin and it lands in his favour as Mahmudullah wrongly calls it as heads. India will have a bowl first.

Brett Lee has his say on the pitch report- He reckons that the middle and the leg stump line will be a worrying side for the fast bowlers. Adds that the first six overs will be the best chance for the bowlers to trouble the batsmen as it looks a good batting track. Opines that once you get over the brand new ball then there will be plenty runs on board. Ends by saying that you should strike with the brand new ball and reckons that 165-170 looks like a par score.

Cricket is a funny game and you shouldn't expect the obvious to be the outcome always. India were favourites to have a cakewalk till the finals even in the absence of their big guns, but to their dismay, they lost the opener against the hosts, Sri Lanka. Hello and welcome once again from R.Premadasa Stadium, Colombo, for the second match of the Tri-Series, where India lock horns with Bangladesh. Bangla Tigers haven't had recent results in their favor when it comes to the shortest format of the game. They have just managed to win one encounter out of the last 13 played and are also coming on the back of a series defeat against the Lankans. They will want to start the series with a victory on the cards. On the other hand, Rohit Sharma and his boys will look to pull up their socks. They will hope to continue their dominance against their opponents and increase their tally to six wins out of six. Let's hope for a cracker of an encounter. Don't go away as we bring the toss and team news in some moments.
